column1: AllowedAggregatedBandwidthIndicates the allowed maximum aggregated bandwidth at the SN side.-allowedAggBW-FDD-DL/UL-r17 indicates the allowed maximum aggregated bandwidth across FDD DL/UL CCs in SCG
column2: -allowedAggBW-TDD-DL/UL-r17 indicates the allowed maximum aggregated bandwidth across TDD DL/UL CCs in SCG
column3: -allowedAggBW-TotalDL/UL-r17 indicates the allowed maximum aggregated bandwidth across all DL/UL CCs in SCG.

column1: bandCombinationIndexThis field indicates the position of a band combination in the supportedBandCombinationList. Band combination entries in supportedBandCombinationList are referred by an index which corresponds to the position of a band combination in the supportedBandCombinationList. Band combination entries in supportedBandCombinationList-UplinkTxSwitch are referred by an index which corresponds to the position of a band combination in the supportedBandCombinationList-UplinkTxSwitch increased by the number of entries in supportedBandCombinationList.
